name: web-red-black-crypto-trading-desktop-flow-screens
title: Red and Black Crypto Desktop Flow
whatItIs: A dark red presentation of three desktop screens with captions: a split sign-up page with a red chart panel, a swap or bridge screen next to a portfolio risk list, and a wallet chart page with a black side panel of transactions.
whatItMeans: A striped red data texture and black panels unify every screen, and the big captions narrate the flow.
techniques: Red striped chart as the identity texture
Split screens half red and half black
Captions beside each screen in bright and dimmed words
Bold red button on black forms

vocabulary.definition: A page divided into two contrasting halves.
A large sentence describing what a screen shows.
A chart pattern used as a decorative graphic.
